addRepo.title: Add a repository
addRepo.body: Paste a GitHub repository URL — DevDigest clones it locally and imports open PRs. API keys aren’t needed here; set them once in <link>Settings → API Keys</link>.

error.body: The onboarding tour failed to render. The DevDigest engine may be unreachable.
